text:
Calcium carbonate is heated. Calcium oxide and carbon dioxide gas are formed.
The equation for the reaction is shown.
CaCO3→  CaO  +  CO2
225kg of calcium carbonate is heated until there is no further change in mass.
The yield of calcium oxide is 85kg.
What is the percentage yield?
37.8
47.2
67.5
85.0
A
B
C
D
subject: Chemistry
